text:
ANTIFRAUD::disable_app_layer_encryption
Description
This command disables application layer encryption for the current
transaction.
Syntax
ANTIFRAUD
::
disable_app_layer_encryption
Examples
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
if
{
[
HTTP
::
header
exists
"Antifraud-Disable-AppLayerEncryption"
]
}
{
ANTIFRAUD
::
disable_app_layer_encryption
log
local0.
"Application Layer Encryption disabled"
}
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
HTTP_REQUEST
